Enabled.description: If set to `true` then the tool will run. Set to `false` and the processor will not run.

Mappings.description: Dictionary mapping source repository names to target repository names. Used to update Git repository links and references in work items during migration. Keys may be a repository name ("Repo") or a project-qualified name ("Project/Repo"); the qualified form takes precedence. Repositories referenced from other (or renamed) projects are resolved by repository ID and rewritten when mapped here or when the target project contains a repository with the same name.

ShouldDropChangedSetLinks.description: When set to true, changeset links in work items will be removed during migration to prevent broken links when repositories are not migrated.

VerifyTargetExists.description: When true, a commit or branch link is only rewritten to the target repository if that commit or branch exists there; otherwise the source link is kept and a warning names the work item, repository and commit. Set to false to rewrite every link without checking (the behaviour before this option existed). Pull request links are dropped either way.
